```{r}
library("here")         # file logistics
library("lme4")         # mixed effects metric
library("lmerTest")     # p values
library("tidyverse")    # code logistics
library("broom.mixed")  # model outputs as data frames
library("emmeans")      # estimated marginal means
library("cowplot")      # merge plots
library("specr")        # specification curves
library("patchwork")    # merge plots

# TO "CENTER" CATEGORICAL PREDICTORS, set the coding to contr.sum (deviations from the average)
options(scipen = 999, contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
```


```{r}
# read in data
wave_2_dfs <- readRDS(here("_data", "_intermediary_data", "wave_2_dfs.RDS"))
```

```{r}
lyrics_mod <- lmer(rating ~ value * Ethnicity + (1|item_ID) + (1 | participant_ID), 
  data = wave_2_dfs$wave_2_lyrics)

anova(lyrics_mod, type = "II")

speeches1_mod <- lmer(rating ~ value * Ethnicity + (1|item_ID) + (1 | participant_ID), 
  data = wave_2_dfs$wave_2_speeches)

anova(speeches1_mod, type = "II")

speeches2_mod <- lmer(rating ~ value * spectrum + (1|item_ID) + (1 | participant_ID), 
  data = wave_2_dfs$wave_2_speeches)

anova(speeches2_mod, type = "II")
```



```{r}
emm <- emmeans(lyrics_mod, ~Ethnicity)
pd  <- plot(emm, comparisons = TRUE, plotit = FALSE)

pd_df <- as.data.frame(pd) %>%
  mutate(x = as.numeric(Ethnicity))

arrow_df <- pd_df %>%
  mutate(
    # arrows pointing from the mean to the limits
    start_left  = the.emmean,
    end_left    = lcmpl,
    
    start_right = the.emmean,
    end_right   = rcmpl
  ) %>%
  
  # pivot into long form so each arrow becomes 1 row
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(start_left, end_left, start_right, end_right),
    names_to = c(".value", "side"),
    names_pattern = "(start|end)_(left|right)"
  ) %>%
  
  # keep only rows where both ends exist
  filter(!is.na(start) & !is.na(end))

ggplot(pd_df, aes(x = x, y = the.emmean)) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL),
    size = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = arrow_df,
    aes(
      x = x, xend = x,
      y = start, yend = end,
      group = interaction(Ethnicity, side)
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    colour = "red"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pd_df$x, labels = pd_df$Ethnicity) +
  theme_classic()
```


```{r}
# lyrics by ethnicity
p1 <- plot(emmeans(lyrics_mod, ~Ethnicity) , comparisons = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("lyrics") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- plot(emmeans(speeches1_mod, ~Ethnicity) , comparisons = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("speeches")+
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- plot(emmeans(speeches2_mod, ~spectrum) , comparisons = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle("speeches")+
  theme_minimal()

plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol=1)
```

```{r}
plot(emmeans(lyrics_mod , ~Ethnicity|value), comparisons =T) +
  theme_minimal()

plot(emmeans(speeches1_mod , ~Ethnicity|value), comparisons =T) +
  theme_minimal()

plot(emmeans(speeches2_mod , ~spectrum|value), comparisons =T) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# run models of subsets by factor to visualize interactions
run_subset_mods <- function(df, factor, formula){
  
  factors <- df %>% select(factor)
  colnames(factors) <- "column"
  factors <- factors$column %>% unique() %>% as.character() %>% as.list(.)
  
  mods <- lapply(factors, function(factor){
    lmer(formula, df%>%filter(genre==factor), REML = TRUE)
  })
}

wave_2_lyrics_mods$lmer %>% 
  tidy() %>% filter(grepl("Ethnicity", term) & p.value < .05)

spec_lyrics_ethnicity <- as.formula("rating ~ Ethnicity * value + (1|participant_ID)+(1|item_ID)")

mods <- run_subset_mods(
  df = wave_2_dfs$wave_2_lyrics,
  factor = "genre",
  formula = spec_lyrics_ethnicity)

plot(emmeans(mods[[21]], ~Ethnicity|value), comparisons = T) + ggtitle("genre 9")
plot(emmeans(mods[[9]], ~Ethnicity|value), comparisons = T) + ggtitle("genre 11")
plot(emmeans(mods[[1]], ~Ethnicity|value), comparisons = T) + ggtitle("genre 19")
plot(emmeans(mods[[11]], ~Ethnicity|value), comparisons = T) + ggtitle("genre 23")
```

```{r}
# run models of subsets by factor to visualize interactions
run_subset_mods <- function(df, factor, formula){
  
  factors <- df %>% select(factor)
  colnames(factors) <- "column"
  factors <- factors$column %>% unique() %>% as.character() %>% as.list(.)
  
  mods <- lapply(factors, function(factor){
    lmer(formula, df%>%filter(party==factor), REML = TRUE)
  })
}

wave_2_speeches_ethnicity_mods$lmer %>% 
  tidy() %>% filter(grepl("Ethnicity", term) & p.value < .05)

spec_speeches_ethnicity <- as.formula("rating ~ Ethnicity * value + (1|participant_ID)+(1|item_ID)")

mods <- run_subset_mods(
  df = wave_2_dfs$wave_2_speeches,
  factor = "party",
  formula = spec_speeches_ethnicity)


plot(emmeans(mods[[1]], ~Ethnicity|value), comparisons = T) + ggtitle("Democratic")
plot(emmeans(mods[[2]], ~Ethnicity|value), comparisons = T) + ggtitle("Republican")
```
